That standing pair is the editorial point: the camera stays on the mouth that is talking and leaves the man who was beaten at the back of the frame, behind Lynn's shoulder, given no coverage at all. A writer can use this for the room that has not caught up yet, not for anyone's reaction - the only face the shot offers is the one with least to answer for. Seven seconds on one dim setup with the blinds behind them, in a film whose median shot is three: it is being let run long on purpose.
